## Tentative tests

| Test | Result | Subtests | Kind | Description |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| [`client-hint-request-headers-2.tentative.htm`](https://wpt.fyi/results/cors/client-hint-request-headers-2.tentative.htm) | Fail | 0 / 1 | NOT IMPLEMENTED | the client hint request headers (`device-memory`, `dpr`, `width`, `viewport-width`...) are not CORS-safelisted request-headers (the Fetch Standard does not list them; only Chrome does), so the request has a preflight, which `cors-makeheader.py` does not allow |
| [`simple-requests-ch.tentative.htm`](https://wpt.fyi/results/cors/simple-requests-ch.tentative.htm) | Fail | 0 / 3 | NOT IMPLEMENTED | the client hint request headers (`save-data`, `device-memory`, `dpr`, `width`, `viewport-width`) are not CORS-safelisted request-headers (the Fetch Standard does not list them; only Chrome does), so the requests have a preflight, which `preflight.py` does not allow |
